product.name: Samsung Galaxy S24
product.notes: 167 g (Sub6) / 168 g (mmWave) per Samsung press specs. 4000 mAh typical, 3880 mAh rated. 6.2 in full rectangle (6.0 in with rounded corners), 2340x1080 Dynamic AMOLED 2X. Rear: 50 MP f/1.8 main (OIS), 10 MP f/2.4 3x telephoto (OIS), 12 MP f/2.2 ultrawide; front 12 MP f/2.2. Armor Aluminum frame, Gorilla Glass Victus 2 front and back. Coordinates: screen down, viewed from back; x=0 at left edge seen from back (the side-key side), y=0 at USB-C end, z=0 at front glass.

sources.title: Samsung Philippines - Galaxy S24 | S24+ specifications
sources.covers: Official dimensions 147.0x70.6x7.6 mm, 167 g, 4000 mAh, 6.2 in display, camera MP/apertures, materials

sources.title: GSMArena - Samsung Galaxy S24 full specifications
sources.covers: Cross-check of dimensions, weight, 15 W Qi wireless charging, model codes, camera focal lengths

sources.title: iFixit - Samsung Galaxy S24 device page
sources.covers: Model code list (SM-S921x), list of available repair guides; no full teardown exists on iFixit

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 Back Cover Replacement
sources.covers: Back cover is glued on all four edges plus a spot above the flash cutout; heat-and-pick removal

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 Motherboard Replacement
sources.covers: Removal order down to motherboard; 13 + 5 + 2 screw counts; connector names/locations; rear cameras ride on the motherboard; ultrawide held by two metal pegs

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 USB-C Port and Daughterboard Replacement
sources.covers: Coil and loudspeaker come out as one assembly; USB-C soldered to daughterboard; daughterboard screws (states 3 x 3.4 mm); two interconnect cables labelled SUB

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 Screen Replacement
sources.covers: Display separates from the frame toward the front (adhesive); separate display cable from bottom-left to the motherboard

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 Battery Replacement (pull tab)
sources.covers: Battery held by pull-tab adhesive film peeled toward the left edge; mmWave and battery cables bent up before removal

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 Screen and Battery Assembly Replacement
sources.covers: Deepest documented disassembly: full order, 24 screws total (3.5/3.4/2.5 mm), SIM tray at bottom, front camera glued in a frame recess, unnamed antenna on conductive tape, mmWave antenna + bracket, daughterboard; residual part = screen + battery + frame

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 Earpiece Speaker Replacement
sources.covers: Earpiece speaker assembly: 5 x 3.5 mm screws, connector pried from its left side

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 Front Camera Replacement
sources.covers: Front camera reachable after earpiece removal; held by strong adhesive/epoxy in a frame recess; press connector

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 Rear Cameras Replacement
sources.covers: Three rear camera modules each on a press connector; removed from the motherboard after it is lifted out

sources.title: iFixit - Galaxy S24 Battery Replacement (alternate, community guide)
sources.covers: Conflicting account: says 8 coil screws and glued battery; treated as low-confidence

sources.title: GSMArena - Samsung Galaxy S24 teardown results in 9/10 reparability score (PBKreviews video)
sources.covers: Dual-layer (stacked) mainboard, vapor chamber about twice the S23's, front camera glued, battery pull tab, individually replaceable rear lens covers, no UWB antenna on base S24

sources.title: SamMobile - Galaxy S24 teardown video shows how easy repair is
sources.covers: Battery on adhesive with pull tab; back panel glued; most internals screwed rather than glued

sources.title: Samsung Mobile Press - Galaxy S24 tech specs (seen via search snippet only)
sources.covers: Weight 167 g Sub6 / 168 g mmWave; rated battery 3880 mAh. Page did not render on fetch, so this is from a search-result summary

sources.title: Subtel retailer listing for S24 replacement battery (seen via search snippet only; low trust)
sources.covers: Third-party battery outline about 68 x 60.1 x 5.1 mm; used only to size the battery bbox

steps.title_en: Front housing: frame with display (service unit)
steps.tools: heat, suction handle, iFlex (only if separating)
steps.cautions: Display is a fragile, adhesive-bonded unit; the service part ships with the battery pre-installed
Never use metal tools on the battery
Seat the USB-C port at an angle first, then clip the top-right corner
Do not separate camera PCB from its housing
Ultrawide hooks onto two pegs; insert at 45 degrees
Route front camera and mmWave cables over the board, then connect them

steps.title_en: Display cable and two interconnect cables
steps.cautions: Press connectors only on flat areas without components
Battery is connected after all internal cables (it is the first thing disconnected after the coil)
Clip the speaker edges into the frame before inserting the 13 screws, then connect the coil
Test the phone before sealing; IP68 is lost unless the adhesive is reapplied well
